flights.notes: Good flight, memorial Day, lots of wings in the air. Waited on launch for the wind to pick up. Gusty and very switchy from w to SW. Couldn't reach speedbar. Big ears approach, good landing with kiting. Kited with Stuart for 30 minutes afterwards, Gusty conditions. Gave app to Stuart for testing.

Practice dolphins.
Practice finding speed bar.
